keys.title: Stored keys
keys.hint: Every secret in the engine's vault. Model keys are managed from Models; this list is for keys other tools use.
keys.emptyHint: Keys you add for models or tools appear here.

models.intro: The endpoints your pekos think with. Each model keeps its own API key; change it under Edit.
models.emptyHint: Add an endpoint and its API key to start talking to your pekos.
models.unavailableHint: Couldn't load the model catalog. Check that the engine is running and reload this tab.

folder.title: Peko folder
folder.hint: Where the engine keeps your pekos, models, and keys.

about.onboardingHint: Walk through connecting a model and creating a peko again.
about.checkFailed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your connection and try again.

language.title: Language
language.hint: The language Peko Desktop is shown in.

devices.title: Devices
devices.hint: Your computers and phones on your PekoHub account. A device on this list reads and acts as you; nothing joins it without a code shown on a device already on it.
devices.notSignedIn: Sign in to PekoHub first. Your devices find each other through PekoHub.
devices.notOnList: This computer is not on your account's devices yet.
devices.joinHow: On a computer or phone already on your account, choose Add a device, then type the code it shows here.
devices.removeConfirm: Remove it? It can no longer act as you.
devices.removeThisConfirm: Remove this computer? It stops acting as you until it joins again.
devices.scanOrType: Scan this with Peko on your phone, or type the code on your other computer.
devices.warning: Whoever uses it acts as you. Show it only to your own device.
devices.devicesReset: PekoHub says someone you talk with set up all their devices again. Approve only if they told you so; until then nothing goes to their new devices.
devices.ownerChange: PekoHub says {{peko}} now belongs to another account. Hand it over? If you didn't give it away, deny: it stays yours.
devices.keyChange: PekoHub says a peko you talk with has a new identity. A peko keeps its identity when it moves to another computer, so approve only if its owner told you they set it up again. Until you decide, nothing you send reaches it.
